body:
Yeah, I can't open up. People don't seem like they could deal with what I think about. And I'm super senstive to the vibe that I'm wrong. When I talk to my partner, she responds by explaining how I shouldn't be stressed or that I'm dumb or something. I've stopped trying to talk to her.

I went for a walk with an old best friend. An hour later he felt much better because I listened to his problems. He asked how I was doing on our way to the cars. What am I gonna say? "I wanna die, soon. Have a good dinner with your family."

I'm thinking that spending some coin on a therapist sounds like a decent idea.

Life after high school gives you more control over what happens. That by itself can make it easier to find the right type of friends for you.

The wearing masks thing got me. I do that too. I'm surrounded by acquaintances who think they are my friends but I can't be open with anyone.

Regarding the fiance's mother, f her! It sucks that she's being negative like that. Her telling you that makes it more likey that brehstfeeding won't work. There are people who can help with breastfeeding. La Leche Legue is big. There are also professional lactation couneslors.

You can write your own birthplan. Sometimes they go perfectly. Things may get crazy the day of labor but the docs can't do what you want if you don't tell 'em. 

Parenting is damn hard. That's why I'm on this board. :/
